provenance.rnnoise_not_used: Current public collection lacks scene labels; user approved a small explicit public non-speech catalog instead.
provenance.scene_scope: Office and coffee are curated non-speech scene approximations, not asserted organizer files. Coffee includes machinery/cup sounds, not crowd babble.
provenance.semantic_screen: Public author descriptions and scene labels; no human-speech dataset or speech subset included.
provenance.split: ESC folds 1-4 train, 5 dev; curated scene recordings held out by original source; shared components grouped transitively.
